description: This file defines the interface for handling block sources in reftable, including functions for opening, reading, closing, and releasing block data, as well as creating in-memory block sources from buffers.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and underlying resource; no operation if source is zero-initialized.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a block of data of specified size from the source at a given offset into the provided destination.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the underlying resource associated with the source.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the given block data.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source from a provided buffer.
